At the regular Board of Commissioners Meeting April 4, 1995, the Board amended our resolution covering volunteer firemen under Worker's Compensation.

A copy of the newly adopted resolution "A RESOLUTION AUTHORIZING CERTAIN ELECTED OFFICIALS OF TREUTLEN COUNTY TO BE COVERED UNDER WORKER'S COMPENSATION: REPEALING RESOLUTIONS OR PARTS OF RESOLUTIONS IN CONFLICT: AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES" is enclosed.

If you have any questions concerning this matter, please do not hesitate to contact me.
